scope: all m=220 degree-11 anchors with r=t-w=2, equivalently S(v)=130
relaxation: A-side global degree labels are relaxed independently to any value 11..17; only the exact aggregate cross-row size 67 is retained. B-side degree labels and column degrees are completely relaxed.
mixed_constraints: each A-to-B row induces a triangle-free subset of B
for every A-edge, the two row intersection is independent in B
for every A-nonedge, the two row union hits every independent 4-set of B
independent A triples/unions hit every independent 3-set of B
independent A 4-sets/unions hit every B nonedge
independent_crosscheck: A separate Python pair/triple-support implementation also excludes all 18 A26/B116 pairs under an even weaker necessary-condition relaxation.
conclusion: In any hypothetical 220-edge R(4,6,36) graph, every degree-11 vertex satisfies r(v)=t(v)-w(v)>=3. Consequently n11 cannot be 1,2,3,or4.
